listing.name: Go Go Ackman (Go Go Ackman Recompiled)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Windows/Linux packages; own Japanese ROM Limits: Native desktop host with emulation-core terminology; actual compiled game dispatch coverage unresolved. Research only. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP and Linux x86-64 Flatpak (frozen v1.0 assets); game-execution native/interpreter coverage remains research, independent of native host CPU. Original data: Own Go Go Ackman Japanese SNES ROM: unheadered size 1,310,720 bytes, SHA-256 e8a33b6c8e15cf0aa60e9694471a51926fb97ad895d4714384c6abff28a33a1f. Optional 512-byte copier header is normalized. English/PT-BR IPS translations are separate optional patches; other ROM revisions require new analysis. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
